title: Earth's core may be leaking a 4.5-billion-year-old secret
caption:
New research suggests some of Earth's carbon may have arrived on ancient meteorites and spent billions of years trapped in the core. By analyzing volcanic crystals, scientists found a chemical signature that links our planet's deep interior to the early solar system.

Source: Sciencedaily - Earth's core may be leaking a 4.5-billion-year-old secret
